title: 越南嫌10%太低：印度7%中国4.5%，汇丰说这里是必争之地？
speaker: Michael Murray Roberts

segments.en: Where specifically do you see the opportunities right now? Yeah, I mean you said Asia's high growth. I mean, I was in Vietnam this week and they're growing at 10% per year.
segments.zh: 您具体看到哪些机会？是的，您说亚洲高增长。我本周在越南，他们每年增长10%。

segments.en: And in fact, they think that's too low if they think it above 10%. I think you just see you know elevated growth rates all throughout Asia India at 7%.
segments.zh: 事实上他们认为这太低，认为应超过10%。整个亚洲增长率都很高，印度7%。

segments.en: China at 4.5 or so and I think that continues that I don't see it slowed down that at all. A lot of it's just increased productivity which leads to you know higher value in the in the economy.
segments.zh: 中国大约4.5%，我认为会持续，没有放缓。很多是生产力提升，带来经济更高价值。

segments.en: Which produces a very virtual cycle and I think we're in that virtual cycle. I think azion in particular is extremely well positioned for a whole host of reasons as trade routes go through azion.
segments.zh: 这产生良性循环，我认为我们正处于其中。亚洲尤其处于极佳位置，原因很多，贸易路线经过亚洲。

segments.en: It's high tech go through azion as wealth comes into azion as you know Singapore is growing as a well center as a Hong Kong. As well they're both growing very quickly and so if that's I think for a bank. It's the place to be.
segments.zh: 高科技经过亚洲，财富流入亚洲，新加坡和香港作为财富中心都在快速增长。对银行来说，这里是必争之地。

segments.en: Not to say that we won't look at and be very present in the other parts of the world. But just the relative performance of Asia along all the various metrics. Much higher much more attractive in Asia how much have higher yields.
segments.zh: 并不是说我们不会关注世界其他地区。但亚洲在所有指标上的相对表现都更高、更具吸引力。
